groups.activity: clear the Uranus Junction, then finish The Duviri Paradox

rows.label: The Duviri Paradox
rows.note: completion awards the Sun & Moon Blueprint, Mountain's Edge stance and a Kaithe

conditions: The Uranus Junction end-of-mission screen also lists "Sun & Moon" as a reward; that's the Drifter-only Duviri copy, not the arsenal blueprint from finishing the quest.

groups.activity: gather plants and Dax drops across the open world
groups.meta: Kovnik and Lamentus keep pace during normal play

rows.label: Kovnik
rows.note: plants across Duviri, sometimes in Teshin's Cave

rows.label: Lamentus
rows.note: drops from Dax enemies in the open world, not the Undercroft

rows.label: Silphsela
rows.note: seeds around Sun Silph plants, heaviest near Titan's Rest

conditions: Don't destroy Sun Silph plants; they keep releasing fresh clusters of about six Silphsela seeds instead of a one-time pickup.
Spend starting Spiral rerolls to fish for the Bountiful Harvest decree; it doubles Kovnik and Silphsela plant pickups, not Lamentus.
bonuses: Resource Boosters apply to all three.

groups.activity: loop map edges for Runic Compact deposits
groups.meta: compacts don't respawn per map, but each new map spawns a fresh set
groups.mode: normal Circuit is enough; Steel Path spawns the same amount

rows.label: Rune Marrow
rows.note: Corrupted Vor and Corrupted Jackal in the Undercroft always drop some

conditions: This is the slowest of the four materials; the story's Undercroft segments alone won't cover 35.

rows.label: Sun & Moon
rows.note: 30,000 cr, 100 Kovnik, 35 Rune Marrow, 40 Lamentus, 45 Silphsela

bonuses: 35 plat rushes the day-long build if you don't want to wait.

disclosures.title: replacing a sold copy
disclosures.body: Only one blueprint is awarded. If you sell or feed the weapon, Cephalon Simaris sells a replacement blueprint for 100,000 standing.
